title: Scalpel: Fine-Grained Alignment of Attention Activation Manifolds via Mixture Gaussian Bridges to Mitigate Multimodal Hallucination

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating factual inconsistencies and object hallucinations using multimodal benchmarks (POPE, MME) to measure the model's tendency to over-rely on inherent text priors rather than aligned visual evidence.
Using the POPE benchmark's 'Popular' sampling strategy to evaluate the model's tendency to hallucinate objects that appear most frequently in the training data.
